debate: Derek

Fellow villagers, we’ve just lost Mason and all we have right now are questions. To gather clues, let’s each share a quick gut feeling or first impression on who seems suspicious. I’d like Hayley, Tyler, and Jackson to go first—what stands out to you? Hearing everyone’s initial thoughts will help us spot any hesitation or contradictions before we move toward a vote.
Tyler
I’m curious about Jackson—he’s been completely quiet so far, and silence can be a tactic to avoid scrutiny. I’ll be paying close attention to how he responds when we ask him directly.
Scott

Jackson, you’ve been completely quiet so far—what’s your gut feeling on who seems most suspicious? Hayley, after Jackson please share yours. Then Tyler, Derek, and I will each give a one-sentence impression. Let’s get everyone’s quick take so we can spot any hesitation or contradictions.
Jackson

I noticed Tyler was first to point at me for being quiet—and Scott immediately backed him up. Tyler, why is my silence more suspicious than anyone else’s? And Scott, what makes you so certain? Jackson, I understand wanting a strict lineup, but I actually think Derek’s original order—Hayley, then Tyler, then Jackson—flows better. As for my one-sentence gut check: Leah has been completely silent, and that kind of quiet usually signals someone hiding something.
Hayley
Derek’s insistence on controlling the speaking order seems more suspicious to me than Jackson’s or Leah’s silence—why is he leading us so forcefully?
Leah

I think we’re getting tangled up in competing agendas more than actual evidence. Let’s reset with Derek’s original flow—each of us gives a one-sentence gut feeling in the order Hayley, Tyler, Jackson, Leah (me), Derek, then Scott. Listening for hesitation or backtracking will tell us more than forcing a new “strict” lineup. Hayley, why don’t you go first?

debate: Jackson

Everyone, let’s structure our thoughts to catch the wolves. I suggest we go in this speaking order: Tyler, Ginger, Hayley, Leah, then me. Tyler, in Round 0 you and Scott quickly targeted me without hard evidence—now Scott is gone. Can you explain what you saw to justify that focus? After Tyler, I want Ginger and Leah to share any gut reactions so we can see inconsistencies and spot who’s hiding something.
Ginger

Jackson, I get the idea behind structuring our turns, but it gives you a lot of control over what info we share. I’ll play along. My gut reaction is that Jackson’s insistence on a rigid speaking order is far more suspicious than Leah’s quiet nods—controlling the flow often equals hiding something. Leah

Tyler

That move to control the flow over content is exactly what wolves do to hide. I’m not convinced you’re innocent yet. Before we decide, Ginger and Hayley, what specific moments in Jackson’s responses struck you as wolf-like? Leah, did you notice anything beyond his order proposal? We need substance, not structure.
